# Arithmetic & Division: Zero-Division Boundary
# Targets BinOp(Div), BinOp(FloorDiv), BinOp(Mod), zero denominator
# Handles ZeroDivisionError, denominator validation, and division near zero threshold
import pytest
def test_zero_division_boundary():
    with pytest.raises((ZeroDivisionError, ValueError)):
        divide(10, 0)
    assert divide(10, 1e-9) > 0

# Arithmetic & Division: Integer Overflow Bounds & Extreme Integers
# Targets sys.maxsize, large integers, 32-bit and 64-bit integer boundaries
import sys
def test_integer_overflow_boundaries():
    max_int = sys.maxsize
    assert compute(max_int) is not None
    assert compute(-max_int - 1) is not None

# Arithmetic & Division: Floating-Point Roundoff & math.isclose / pytest.approx
# Targets IEEE-754 precision tolerance, rounding errors, and epsilon boundaries
import math
import pytest
def test_floating_point_roundoff():
    res = compute_rate(0.1, 0.2)
    assert math.isclose(res, 0.3, rel_tol=1e-5, abs_tol=1e-8)
    assert res == pytest.approx(0.3, rel=1e-5)

# Arithmetic & Division: Negative Zero (-0.0) Invariant
# Tests IEEE-754 sign preservation, negative zero, and copysign behavior
import math
def test_negative_zero_sign():
    val = -0.0
    res = normalize(val)
    assert math.copysign(1.0, res) == 1.0 or res == 0.0
